messages.subject: Rdistance
parts:
Hi all!
I am looking for a way to use the Rdistance package with my line transect data where the exact distance has not been recorded but only whether the observation was made inside or outside a count band. With this kind of data, can any Rdistance function be used to estimate density? 

Thank you so much!!

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] Rdistance
parts:
Alvaro

I'm afraid this email list is not intended to address questions about the package Rdistance​, but rather this list is devoted to dealing with general questions about distance sampling and with software-related questions arising from the Distance for Windows software and the R package Distance​.   Both of those pieces of software can analysis data collected in bins. Consult
http://distancesampling.org/

for details about the software.

If you examine issues related to the Rdistance​ package, you will see that analysis of binned data is proposed. Consult this link
https://github.com/tmcd82070/Rdistance/issues/96
